# codewiki

> Code-anchored knowledge base. Every page lists `sources` (symbol id + hash) verified against HEAD by `kb verify`.

## Docs

- [index.md](index.md): layered table of contents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): writing schema
- [facts/routes.json](facts/routes.json), [facts/testids.json](facts/testids.json), [facts/apis.json](facts/apis.json), [facts/requirements.json](facts/requirements.json): machine-readable facts
